Name: ClavicleAdvance
Description: This will create a Clavicle Advance system

attrs.Help_string: What this block does: This will create a Clavicle Advance system. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. Mirror: choose one option (for example: True, False, Right_Only). TwistAmount: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4). Ribbon: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. SetGameParent: set the node/object name this block should use. Tip: if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly. Template parent examples: L_Clavicle_Jnt, L_Clavicle_Ctrl, StellarClavicle.
